name: nightlight-webos
description: webOS homebrew app for LG TVs that turns Eye Comfort Mode (blue light filter) on at sunset and off at sunrise, or at times you set.

scripts.deploy: node -e "const a = require('./app/appinfo.json'); require('child_process').execSync('ares-install dist/' + a.id + '_' + a.version + '_all.ipk', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
